verdict.rationale: Fireworks is an AI inference and fine-tuning platform, so in-product AI insights about a user's own data (usage, deployments, datasets) is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack only documents developer building blocks: model APIs, tool calling, structured outputs and vision analysis. Those let developers construct such features, but they are not an in-product insights capability. The guided fine-tuning plan flow is an adjacent feature that generates a training plan from a task description, not insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data.
